full_page.content:
Page 165
Nov. 5th E'd R. Brock - 45 - City constable believed to be dying three weeks ago. His sister phoned Wednesday P.M. to ask for prayers for him - leaving the telephone she found his blood circulation had come back and he is improving ever since. Thanks be to God.
Rose Krisak - 22 - Kiefers Hosp. with T.B.
Mrs. Anna Siebers - 67 - of Rochester N. Y. - lost a leg .. not well ..
7 Mrs. Cath. Bannsback - 70 - broken-hip since last April - very slow in improving - in continual pain. Husband has given up religion for many years.
Auelia Mercurio - 33 - Slight nerv .- Bk ....
8 Mrs. Barbara Bopp - 58 - slight stroke recently ... has been losing weight rapidly .....
Mary A. Zemcik - 28 mo. - very peculiar. Almost two years has not laughed or cried. Till a few months ago when we asked prayers for her and enrolled her she was unable to hold her head up .... now can almost stand alone
Page 166 Nov. 8th V. Sister M. Grace Anita - O.P. - D. Adrian - "Adiran's Sickness"- Drs. in Chicago give no hope of recovery - Her sister also a nun asks for prayers.
9th Thomas Fox - 48 - Ulcer of liver and apendicitis - Grace Hosp. - Enrolled .... $1.00
12 Worse To-day - Relic of Fr. Stephens given ...
9th Mrs. Julia Markes - about 50 - gangreen-foot. Drs. in Ann Arbor Hospital tried to induce her to have leg amputated .... She insisted notwithstanding great pain on leaving Hospital and coming hither. Here To-night and enrolled (2.00) .. 15th Decidedly better. Jan. 11, '40 Saw her To-day - foot saved, alive again.
Thomas Magner - 16 - was cured at 3. of infantile paralysis
10th Gerard Eggleston - 8 - of Gr. Rapids - very slow in learning though wants to be a priest. Enrolled To-day 506
Mrs. Jessie Adams - 50 - has very disagreeable neighbor .... wishes he - being alone and could easily - move somewhere away from some house.
